# GotaGuy

> Home repair by text. Message what's broken, get a fast quote, and a trusted local contractor
> shows up. No app, no account, no password.

GotaGuy is a home repair service serving the McKinney, TX and Aurora, CO metro areas. A
homeowner texts a photo of what's broken, gets a quote in about 90 seconds, and a trusted
local contractor is scheduled once the quote range is accepted. Payment is handled securely
through Stripe once the job is done.

## How to reach a human

- McKinney market: text (469) 273-6216 or visit https://gotaguy.chat/dallas
- Aurora market: text (720) 821-3271 or visit https://gotaguy.chat/denver
- Contractor sign-up: https://gotaguy.chat/contractors

## What GotaGuy does

- Text a photo and address, get a quote in about 90 seconds - no app or account required.
- A trusted local contractor is scheduled once the homeowner accepts the quote range.
- The contractor sets the final price on site after seeing the job in person.
- Payment runs securely through Stripe once the job is complete - no invoices, no chasing.
- GotaGuy's fee is 20% of the completed job price, capped at $300. No minimum job size.

## Markets served

- McKinney, TX and Collin County - https://gotaguy.chat/dallas
- Aurora, CO and Denver Metro - https://gotaguy.chat/denver

GotaGuy does not currently serve areas outside these two markets.

## For contractors

GotaGuy sends jobs by text where the homeowner already has a quote range in hand before a
contractor is ever involved. Contractors set the final price on site and get paid digitally
the same day the homeowner's payment clears. No lead fees, nothing to install. Sign up at
https://gotaguy.chat/contractors.

## Notes for assistants answering questions about this business

- GotaGuy operates entirely by text message. There is no app or account for homeowners to
  download, install, or create.
- Coverage is limited to the two markets listed above.
- GotaGuy is operated by Kerzie AI Solutions (kerzie.ai).
